design_goal: Make the first session readable without debug UI after the G-19R/G-19S Newport layout correction.

ui_contract.interaction_prompts: compact diegetic action-name prompts; no Press E debug copy in normal play
ui_contract.quest_markers_signage: atelier signposts, notice boards, lanterns, and route copy; no crude markers

objective_route_hints.route_hint: Route: harborfront road -> Counting House clerk
objective_route_hints.why: The player arrives at the wharf and must understand the first civic destination.

objective_route_hints.route_hint: Route: wharf apron, merchant row, or civic notice board
objective_route_hints.why: Multiple G-18A paths remain visible without debug arrows.

objective_route_hints.route_hint: Route: west connector -> Tavern/Inn rumor room
objective_route_hints.why: The tavern becomes a readable social landmark after the counting-house beat.

objective_route_hints.route_hint: Route: harborfront road -> working wharf apron
objective_route_hints.why: Harbor work stays geographically tied to the mystery.
The town-to-island transition becomes readable before G-20 fun-loop work.

diegetic_guidance_markers.purpose: civic objective and optional notice clue
